research.notes: Unconfirmed candidate: 'Elevate Adolescence Program' (elevateadolescence.com; programs Girls Rising Strong and Boys Breaking Through; search snippets show a 470 (Atlanta-area) phone and a Gmail address). The site refused connections (ECONNREFUSED) so no page could be fetched or cited, no registry entry (ProPublica, GuideStar, Georgia SOS) was found, and nothing links it to OUSD. Not Elevate Atlanta Inc (EIN 86-2336687), whose mission and name differ, nor Elevate Oakland. Needs manual review.
